messages:
adan: Heads up — after the kernel-selector refactor I see host CPU for ingress jump ~3-4x on small reqs (<1KB). gRPC streaming p50/p95 climbed. lots of tiny writev syscalls and tokenizer CPU.
marta: saw same on canary. pprof points at net.writev + tokenizer.Tokenize hot paths. kvcache miss rate spiked for similar traffic shape.
adan: forcing pre-refactor selector brings numbers back down. looks like selector change is the trigger.
sahil: diff shows we switched to latency-first kernels for many variants. for short sequences that reduces batching (selector prefers single-request kernels) => smaller batches + more writes.
jun: also saw parser now slices streams per-frame instead of coalescing—adds syscall overhead before GPU.
marta: quick pprof snippet: 
```
30.1% net.Writev
21.4% tokenizer.Tokenize
12.0% runtime.mallocgc
8.5%  ingress.ParseFrame
6.0%  kvcache.Lookup (miss)
```
matches flamegraph.
adan: HPACK churn also up when we don't coalesce — header table penalties on many small frames.
sahil: mitigation: revert kernel-policy flip for small-seq traffic + re-enable stream coalesce. also add min_batch_size=4 for latency-first kernels.
jun: agree. instrument selection metrics (kernel_policy, chosen_kernel, est_batch_size) — currently opaque.
marta: I'll try a proxy coalesce at ingress: buffer up to 8 frames or 2ms then flush. minimal latency impact, should cut writev frequency.
adan: plan: canary A/B: rollback selector + proxy coalesce. if good, refine selector heuristics.
ci-bot: jun/test-kernel-rollback triggered - smoke tests running.
deploy-bot: canary rollback in us-east-2 started by adan.
sahil: followups: add metric redwood_runtime_kernel_policy_choice (label), gauge ingress_coalesce_buffer_depth, and trace span tokenization->kvcache lookup correlation.
marta: i'll own proxy coalesce PR, opening in 10m. need someone to collect pprof/syscall traces for canary.
jun: i'll capture pprof and syscall trace: `pprof -http=:6060 ./profiles/cpu.pprof` and `sudo perf record -e syscalls:sys_enter_writev -a -g -- sleep 30`.
adan: thanks. if rollback+coalesce don't fix tail we can tokenize cheaply on host to estimate token counts pre-selection so batching heuristics are accurate.
marta: note: KV eviction rate looked worse for multitenant small requests — might be eviction policy side-effect of refactor. will add eviction_hit_rate metric.
sahil: on watch for canary, will report numbers. :thumbsup:
adan: captured. will update when canary numbers land.
